roleReuse.description: One original photograph is registered in two input roles; this does not add cross-person ground truth.

limits: Only two female front-facing catalogue inputs and two upper garments; insufficient for general body type, occlusion, pose, background or clothing coverage.
The flat-lay value is the inference treatment setting; source catalogue garment photography was not independently confirmed to be physically flat laid.
Cross-person garment transfer has no same-person same-target-outfit photograph ground truth.
Original-worn reconstruction has a paired original photo but does not provide an independent before/after cross-outfit triplet.
Agent visual review is not user scoring; pass is limited to the named visible criterion.
Baseline body and real-wear similarity fail: generated garment fit/folds and original trouser waist/button position differ.
Pretrained deployment and integration are self-hosted; the core pretrained model is not independently trained by this project.
GPU peak memory values are the recorded sampling process scope, exclude other applications, and are not whole-system memory requirements.
Image generation completion and small-kernel probes do not establish real garment sizing, comfort, textile physics or all-machine compatibility.
Runtime saves normalized inputs and outputs; no automatic deletion or independent full network capture was performed for this record.
Photos and human parser have non-commercial research restrictions; main model Apache terms do not remove those restrictions.
